info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Aspen Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Aspen Produce Detail Management API enables users to efficiently create and manage detailed catalog information for Aspen produce items. This API is essential for businesses looking to maintain an up-to-date inventory, allowing input of specific product attributes and descriptions. Typical users include inventory managers and suppliers who require a centralized method to document and track produce details. By streamlining the catalog creation process, this API supports improved product visibility and availability in the marketplace.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for Aspen produce. It expects a request body containing the necessary information for the produce and returns the created details upon success.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the Aspen Produce operation. It contains the information required to successfully process the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the requested produce.

CreateCatalogAspenProduceDetailRequest.title: Aspen Produce Request Body

aspen_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the Aspen produce item.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity that is requesting the produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of the Aspen produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Aspen produce.

CreateCatalogAspenProduceDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for creating or requesting an Aspen Produce operation.

CreateCatalogAspenProduceDetailResponse_.title: Operation Response

status.description: The current status of the operation.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record processed by the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogAspenProduceDetailResponse_.description: Response schema for the operations POST request, containing the status and details of the operation.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource. Typically this is 'application/json' to signify that the response body is in JSON format.

x-processing-time.description: Denotes the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can help clients understand the performance of the API.
